court.name: Supreme Court of the United States

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit, and motion for leave to proceed further in forma pauperis, denied.

attorneys: E. C. Samples, pro se. Assistant Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Berge, and Mr. W. Marvin Smith for the United States.
